We are seeing a lot of people having issues with the game crashing when they enter a new location or try to access some of the new content.

There is a very easy solution to this. The crashes are happening due to Mods you have subscribed to through Steam Workshop.

To fix this issue. 

1. Unsubscribe from all of your Mods. You can right click on the BoneTown icon where you usually start the game and go to the Properties option. In this window, go to the Workshop tab. Here you can see all of the MODs you are subscribed to. Unsubscribe from all of them.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/749d94243eaf72db11ace6f61d23764c7b2012dd.jpg[/img]

C:\ProgramFiles(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\BoneTown\

3. Delete the "workshop" folder

4. Go to the "\game" folder and delete the "MODS" folder

5. Don't open the game yet, uninstall the game and download it again without anything from the workshop.

We have updated all of the MODs we created, but we have no control over when the creators of the other MODs will update their content to work with the new Kinks DLC stuff.

We apologize for this inconvenience. We really want to support the Workshop community, but it bring lots of other issues with it.

We lowered the number of characters attacking you, but also lowered the number of random people walking around (even when you have the game on max character count), so there will be a lot less of bringing random people into your fight by accidentally hitting them. notes.title: FIGHTING IN THE SECOND COMING EDITION
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/a68f0023aea6feaf371fc69edb7ee2a2a90d2b13.jpg[/img]

One thing BoneTown fans have asked for over and over is the ability to fight with teammates. You had that ability in our other title, BoneCraft, but until now, BoneTown was just about kicking everyone else’s butt. And okay, in BoneTown: Second Coming Edition, it’s still mostly about kicking everyone else’s butt--but sometimes it’s also about helping out the little guy, too. So with the addition of competitions like Help Out a Hebrew and JailBreak, we’ve added different ways to interact with the wacky personalities of BoneTown. From helping them get laid to freeing them from LaMigra Headquarters, you now can work with BoneTownians as much as you mess them up.

Another way the Second Coming Edition is different is that this version of BoneTown is also a much wilder place. With fights now breaking out on the streets, you have to keep an eye out in case some drunken idiot decides you’re the next person on his hit list. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/d2324c5cec4f4f53c0c66fd196178bbeb26ed723.jpg[/img]

In the Second Coming Edition, you will also have to be more careful with the girls you hit on. Not all the girls in BoneTown are available. Some have boyfriends, husbands, or jealous suitors taking offense to your advances on their chicks. 

Finally, we wanted to address the monotony of fighting people who all used the same attacks. So we’ve added plenty more individuals and competitions that allow you to fight against people using drugs and powermoves just as you do.

BoneTown has never been a peaceful place, and in the new edition we cranked that up to eleven. So, when hitting the mean streets of BoneTown on the hunt for tang, remember, this town’s about more than just getting it on . . . so watch your back.

We wish every country allowed adults to make their own decisions when it comes to the video games they play, but there is nothing else we can do.
